timeline.text: Welcome to Decompressing After Holding It Together All Day. I will guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you will hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let us begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I have been holding it together all day.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My mind is finally allowed to slow down.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I have been managing everyone else's needs and reactions.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I notice how much energy that took.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body feels worn out from staying composed.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I want to stop performing and just exist.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Part of me has been holding back all day.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit how tired I actually am.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: It has taken a lot to get through today.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that is completely okay. Keep breathing, and we will continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can let this composure soften now.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I do not have to perform anymore right now.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I can release what I was holding for other people.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I am allowed to feel however I actually feel.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can finally exhale.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I can let today's effort be enough.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I do not owe anyone my composure right now.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can take up this quiet space for myself.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can let the day fall away.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You do not need the feeling to disappear. See if there is simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I am allowed to fully unwind.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My mind can rest from managing everything.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I trust myself to show up again tomorrow.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can be completely myself right now.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can finally settle.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I did enough today.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I am allowed to just be, without holding anything up.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can receive this rest fully.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I am ready to let go for tonight.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
